svg.title: Cold, warm, and cached are different measurements
svg.desc: Cache categories per baseline capture. The two CLI structural digests reconstruct only the prefix shape and do not carry response cache fields, so their bars are shown as a single logical-footprint block: Copilot CLI about 14,877, Claude CLI about 27,217, cache usage not captured. The Copilot in VS Code export does carry cache details: the warm MCP-off capture reports 20,598 total made of 9,745 cache read plus 10,853 uncached input. A separate cold MCP-on capture reports 46,428 with zero cached, confirming the prefix is real input even when later reads are cheap. Cache reuse lowers price but does not remove tokens from context.
svg.text: A cheap first call does not mean a small prefix
Logical footprint vs cache read vs uncached input. Only the VS Code export carries cache fields.
shape digest — cache usage not captured
relay digest — cache usage not captured
Copilot in VS Code (cold, MCP on)
cached 0 — full prefix billed as input
Logical footprint — cache fields not captured
The warm VS Code call reports 9,745 cache-read tokens though the conversation was fresh; the cold MCP-on call bills all 46,428 as input.
Cache reuse lowers price, not context size: a cached 20k prefix still occupies ~20k of the model's window. CLI cache fields not captured in shape digests.
